items.titleEn: Second day of the Speed Skating World Cup in Beijing, Chinese team takes 2 golds and 2 bronzes
items.summaryEn: China News Agency Beijing November 14 (Xinhua) The Beijing International Speed Skating World Cup for the 2026-2027 season is the second day of competition at the National Speed Skating Hall in Beijing. The Chinese team won two gold medals and two bronze medals: Liang Wen, Ning Zhuang, and Wang received gold medals in the men's 500m and men's 1500m, while Guangdong Yu won the men' s 500m and Han Mei won the women' s 1500m.

items.title: APEC朋友圈丨中国无人机如何改变智利农田
items.summary: 依托APEC合作平台，中国智慧农业技术远渡重洋来到智利。作为全球地形最狭长的国家，智利南北绵延4352公里，复杂地貌给农耕带来不少挑战。来自中国的无人机能够深入山区作业，不受泥泞地块限制，一定程度上破解了当地农业生产成本高、劳动力短缺的难题。一架架农用无人机，不仅重塑当地传统农耕模式，还催生“农业飞手”这一新职业，让科技发展的红利直达普通农户，为亚太共同发展注入务实力量。
items.titleEn: APEC friends discuss how Chinese drones are changing Chile's agricultural lands
items.summaryEn: On the basis of APEC's collaborative platform, China's smart agricultural technology has come to Chile across the ocean. As the world's smallest country by land area, Chile stretches 4,352 km from north to south, and its complex landscape poses many challenges to agriculture. Drones from China have been able to operate in mountainous areas without being restricted by muddy terrain, which to some extent has solved the difficult problems of high agricultural production costs and labor shortages in the area. A farmer's drone, not only reshaping the traditional local farming model, but also giving rise to a new career in agriculture, which will allow technology development dividends to reach ordinary farmers and give practical impetus to the development of Asia-Pacific.

China continues to play a leading role in this process and has become a key bridge for connecting all parties.

items.titleEn: A new round of cold air is expected to bring much of our country to the brink of cooling.
items.summaryEn: Today (December 14), most of the country's rainfall is still scarce, rain and snow are scattered, and the effects of cold air are in the final stages. However, starting tomorrow, a new wave of stronger cold air will be delivered from northern Xinjiang, which will gradually bring cooler weather to much of China, while rainfall will increase in southwest, Jianghan and other areas.
